usage: python PoC-takeaway/build.py            # all assets from committed, authorized results (~10 min: GIFs re-verify physics)

python PoC-takeaway/build.py --refresh-p17  # refuses unless P17_FINAL_MANIFEST.json + UNSEALED exist and the sealed manifest is on origin/main; then fills P17 columns in 03/04 and re-selects all five GIFs from the P17 test by fixed rules
about: Inputs for build.py. Every number in the figures is computed by build.py from the files named here (or quoted from the named report line). P17 results stay PENDING until --refresh-p17 passes its custody checks.

colors.palette_note: Checked with an OKLab distance + Machado CVD simulation script (the dataviz node validator is not installed here): worst normal-vision dE 18.0 (A-C), worst CVD dE 7.9 (A-C, inside the 6-8 band that is legal only with secondary encoding) - every colour is always paired with a text label. B+G is a lighter step of B on purpose (a B variant). Orange is left to the simulator target; green / amber / red are reserved for outcome status.

dataset.labels: runs/p17/data/{train,dev,val,calib,p17train,p17calib}/labels_*.json (protocol P17_EXISTENTIAL_V1; 326 development scenes; committed at a4a15414)

definitions.scenes: development scenes with P17 existential labels (P16 train / dev / val / calib + p17train + p17calib); each scene generated independently (no base x variant hierarchy is recorded, so that column is dropped)
definitions.feasible as is / blocked / unknown: certified status of the target action in the unmodified scene: VERIFIED / CERTIFIED_INFEASIBLE or STATIC_INVALID / anything else (never counted as blocked)
definitions.repair plans checked: len(sequences): 1-4 move ordered repairs physically verified one by one (existential verifier); generated total = sum of catalogue['generated'] (shown in the footnote)
definitions.blocked scenes repaired: blocked scenes with >= 1 repair sequence labelled y = 1 (VERIFIED + replay CLEAR) / all blocked scenes

dataset.extra_training: P13 constructor scenes used only for B training / validation under an older labelling protocol: 440 train + 74 val (responses-phases/0094 section 2)
missing: base-scene x variant counts: not recorded in any plan (column dropped)
P17 test outcomes: sealed (only scene counts used)
P16 test outcomes: P16 greedy protocol, not mixed into this table

results.success_definition: A-C: strict task success on decided originals = correct no-move on a feasible scene (VERIFIED) or a verified + replayed repair on a blocked scene; denominator 112 (72 feasible + 40 blocked). D: plan found + independent replay CLEAR; denominator 21 common roots (21 of 48 planned D roots were run before the P16 execution cap)

groups.heading: Choosing a repair  —  P16 test, 112 scenes

rows.label: Approach A
rows.configuration: B_TEST arm 'A': the A architecture retrained on the P16 training data (3 seeds, ensemble; report 0088 'A (retrained)'). This is what scored 55/112. The frozen P13 A checkpoint is arm 'P13:A' (61/112 = 37 + 24) and is NOT the configuration shown.
rows.p17_note: P17 arm 'A' = A retrained on the P17 data (same role as P16 'A'); 'P13:A' also runs in P17 but is not used

rows.label: Approach B
rows.configuration: B_TEST arm 'LB': production lean B (exact factorized scene + order-aware repair unaries, no learned coupling), P16 retrain, 3 seeds
rows.not_shown: experimental variant LB+G (generic-only coupling) 73/112 (Holm p 0.0003 vs LB, one test set) - kept out of the public table

rows.label: Approach C
rows.configuration: B_TEST arm 'P13:K-C': the historical C checkpoint frozen in P13, run unchanged in the P16 test
rows.not_shown: LC (lean B with GRU order, a P16 control, NOT historical C) 64/112

groups.heading: Searching for a rearrangement  —  P16 test, 21 constructed scenes  (different task: not comparable with A–C)

rows.label: Approach D
rows.configuration: D_TEST guide 'Dp16': P16 production D (pairless blocker model, feasibility-only recursion) guiding the shared corrected search
rows.evidence: per_guide.Dp16 21/21 and per_guide.geometry 21/21; primary Dp16 vs geometry 0 discordant (UNDERPOWERED); motion checks 117.0 vs 115.0
rows.p17_note: P17 production D on the P17 test (D roster, 90 scenes) and retrospective; separate protocol from A-C

gifs.protocol: P16 frozen test (sealed then unsealed in P16). A/B/C panels: the arm's recorded choice, re-verified deterministically with the P16 sequence verifier (status must equal the record). D panel: P16 production D (Dp16) plan, regenerated and accepted only if its replay hash equals the recorded Dp16 hash. Robot motion is drawn only from certified arrays.
gifs.p17_rule: --refresh-p17 re-selects all five slots from the unsealed P17 test: first root in plan order matching each contrast (A/B/C: strict task success as in the analysis; D: found + replay CLEAR), preferring roots executed by all four; no match -> PENDING slot.
